title: Garreg Mach Exterior Road
prompt:
Morning fog drifts across the mountain road as Garreg Mach monastery rises in the distance. Tiny escort silhouettes move slowly along the path. The monastery should feel sacred, remote, and politically imposing.

Camera: wide slow push toward the distant monastery.
